specificationName: Activity Lifecycle E2E Validation with Multi-Tenant Scoping
status: GAP-9 CLOSED - Multi-tenant scoping enforced at 3 levels

changesApplied.changeMade: Enabled production multi-tenant scope filtering. Changed from dev mode (returns all templates) to production mode with WHERE clause filtering by scope (NULL, 'global', 'org', 'project'). Three query branches: (1) org_id + project_id: filters global + org + project templates, (2) org_id only: filters global + org templates, (3) no org_id: filters global templates only.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces GAP-9 multi-tenant isolation. Prevents cross-tenant data leakage by ensuring users only see templates they have access to. Global templates visible to all, org-scoped templates only to org members, project-scoped templates only to project members.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk. Query change is additive (adds WHERE clause). Maintains backward compatibility with global templates. Affects all template queries via list_all_templates() which is called by: (1) list_activity_templates endpoint, (2) template search, (3) recommendation engine. Database must have scope, org_id, project_id columns in activity_template table.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added org_id and project_id parameters to insert_execution() function signature and data dictionary. Updated docstring to document multi-tenant scoping. org_id and project_id now stored with every execution record for future filtering and pattern analysis.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces multi-tenant isolation at data storage level. Enables future queries to filter executions by org_id/project_id. Critical for pattern extraction (GAP-3) and activity evolution (GAP-6) to respect tenant boundaries. Allows dashboard to show org-specific activity history.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk. Function signature change requires all callers to pass org_id/project_id. Three callers updated: (1) learning_loop.py POST /executions (primary MCP path), (2) activity.py POST /executions (deprecated), (3) actions/activity.py (internal). Database schema must support org_id/project_id fields in activity_execution table. Null values acceptable for backward compatibility.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added credentials parameter to endpoint signature. Extracted org_id from JWT token using get_current_user(). Pass org_id/project_id to _process_execution_background() which forwards to insert_execution(). Updated background task signature to accept org_id/project_id parameters.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces end-to-end multi-tenant isolation from API entry point to database storage. JWT token extraction ensures org_id is derived from authenticated user, not client-provided data (security). Completes data flow: OpenCode → MCP → CLI → POST /executions (extract org_id) → insert_execution (store org_id) → SurrealDB.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk. Credentials parameter is Optional, maintains backward compatibility with anonymous calls. org_id extraction wrapped in try/except, failures logged but don't block execution recording. Background task signature change is internal, no external API impact. Database writes remain async (non-blocking).

dataFlow.before: OpenCode → MCP → CLI → POST /executions → insert_execution(no org_id) → SurrealDB (no filtering) → list_all_templates(return all)
dataFlow.after: OpenCode → MCP → CLI → POST /executions → extract org_id from JWT → insert_execution(org_id, project_id) → SurrealDB (with org_id/project_id) → list_all_templates(WHERE scope filter)
